summary: Iteration 3 focused on validating the new AAB v1.2.3 release (Android targetSdkVersion=36, billing library 8.0.0) is served correctly by the backend download endpoints without regressions to existing APIs or frontend. Created a new test file /app/backend/tests/test_downloads.py (5 tests) covering: GET /api/downloads listing includes both caregiver-sync-v1.2.3.aab and v1.2.1.aab with correct size (~6.2MB) and URL shape; GET /api/download/caregiver-sync-v1.2.3.aab returns 200 with content-type application/octet-stream, Content-Disposition attachment, streams >5MB; GET /api/download/caregiver-sync-v1.2.1.aab still serves (regression on whitelist); non-whitelisted / path-traversal filenames return 404; POST /ai/handover free-tier gating shape verified (fresh user is not 402 on first call). Re-ran full regression suite from iteration 2 (22 pytest tests). Frontend smoke test on preview URL: home renders 'Buongiorno' + 'Caregiver Sync — Anziani & Cronici', no console errors, patient creation flow works end-to-end (POST /api/patients called from UI, quick-stats card updated to 1 assistito, toast 'Assistito registrato' shown). Grand total 27/27 pytest tests pass in ~5s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ALLOWED_DOWNLOADS is correctly extended with caregiver-sync-v1.2.3.aab (line 554). Old v1.2.1 entry kept — good, avoids breaking any external links.
server.py /download/{filename}: FastAPI path param decodes '..' before the whitelist check, so path-traversal attempts get rejected at the `filename not in ALLOWED_DOWNLOADS` step. Safe.

server.py /downloads still builds URL from env PUBLIC_URL; if PUBLIC_URL is unset, returns a relative URL. Acceptable but consider falling back to request.base_url so links are absolute in every deployment.

AAB v1.2.3 size (6,200,327 bytes) is only ~30KB larger than v1.2.1 despite the targetSdk 36 + billing 8.0.0 upgrade. Sanity: reasonable for gradle metadata bump only. If the main agent expected larger asset changes, this may indicate the AAB rebuild picked up only manifest/plugin changes — worth confirming with `bundletool dump manifest` before Play Console upload.
Deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') still present in server.py (flagged in iterations 1 & 2). Unchanged.
App.js still ~1400 lines — splitting overdue (flagged in iteration 2).
seed_data_creation: Frontend smoke test created 1 patient 'TEST_UITest_Nonna' and cleaned up via DELETE /api/data/wipe. Backend pytest autouse fixture wipes DB between tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files now: test_caregiver_api.py (22 tests, wipes DB between tests) and test_downloads.py (5 tests, no DB pollution). test_downloads.py auto-loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if not exported. Whitelist for /api/download is defined in server.py lines 550-566 — update ALLOWED_DOWNLOADS whenever a new release artifact needs to be served. New AAB caregiver-sync-v1.2.3.aab (6.2MB, mtime Sep 6 11:41) is confirmed reachable at /api/download/caregiver-sync-v1.2.3.aab with correct headers. /ai/handover 402 path was validated only for shape (fresh user gets 404 on nonexistent patient, meaning gating didn't fire). To fully exercise the 402 branch, seed 3 handover docs in db.handovers with matching app_user_id and current-month created_at, then POST — omitted here to avoid LLM calls and cost.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Play Console 2026 upgrade (targetSdk 36, billing 8.0.0) did not regress the download endpoint or any other backend/frontend surface.
